# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 28 Oct 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Home Prices & Sales — Q3 2026 Flash

- **Private home prices rose 1.4% in Q3 2026, the fastest pace in nearly two years** - URA data released 23 October shows prices accelerated from 0.5% in Q2, marking the strongest quarterly gain since 2024. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/singapore-private-home-prices-rise-1-4-in-q3-2026-amid-a-quieter-new-launch-calendar/)

- **Price gains came even as overall private home sales fell 16.3% to 5,146 units** - Stacked Homes notes the price increase was driven in part by projects such as Lentor Gardens Residences and higher land costs, while transaction volumes hit their lowest point this year. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/private-home-prices-rose-fastest-pace/)

- **Condo resale volumes recovered in September 2026, rising 10.8% month-on-month to an estimated 1,093 units** - Price gains were largely driven by stronger performance in the Core Central Region (CCR). [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)

## HDB Resale Market — Q3 2026

- **HDB resale transactions hit a two-year high of 7,645 flats in Q3 2026, even as prices slipped 0.1%** - Prices have now declined for a third consecutive quarter, while transaction volumes surged 19.5% and million-dollar flat deals reached a record 596 in the same period. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/hdb-resale-prices-fell-last-quarter/)

## Land Market & New Supply

- **EL Development won the Marina Gardens Lane GLS tender with a single bid of S$450.1 million (S$1,243 psf ppr)** - URA officially awarded the site on 26 October 2026; the winning bid came in approximately 12% below what Kingsford paid for the adjacent One Marina Gardens site. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/marina-gardens-lane-gls-tender-results/)
